messages:
maya: Hey team — intake from VaultDocs via support ticket 9873. They want an instruct-style variant of archai/archipelago-15b with 64k context, INT4 quant, and deterministic responses for doc retrieval. High business priority: they may buy Dedicated if latency and quality pass. Details: l5 regulatory data, no PII allowed in logs. Link: https://tickets.internal/9873

alvin: Nice. First questions: exact base checkpoint? license compatibility? do they require instruction fine-tune or can we use prompt templates on base? Also what latency/throughput SLOs?

maya: Base checkpoint is archai/archipelago-15b-raw (MIT-ish license in ticket). Customer asked for instruct tuning but also said they'd accept prompt engineering if we can meet quality. Target is 200ms/token at 2k context for 1-vCPU warm path; realistic? They want 5k concurrent tokens/day baseline.

sam: Business note: medium-high. If we can guarantee RLHF-like instruct behavior we can upsell Dedicated. Prioritize safety evals early.

rita: Infra note: 64k context for 15b + INT4 needs ~60GB host mem for kv cache on our current A100 pool. We'll need to bench on 80GB A100 or 80GB H100. Quantization pipeline should include outlier detection or we'll see quality cliffs.

alvin: Proposed plan:
 - quick smoke quant (int4 G=64) on a small validation set
 - run our standard LLM-eval suite (instructions, summarization, code, retrieval) and custom VaultDocs prompt set
 - compare against baseline instruct-tuned 13b (redwood/ref-instruct-13b) for regressions
 - safety scans
 - canary in Dedicated for VaultDocs

maya: Running initial quant now, command:
```
./scripts/quantize.sh --model archipelago-15b-raw --bits 4 --group 64 --outlier-threshold 2.5 --save /tmp/archi-15b-int4
```

maya: Quick eval results (after q4 G64, no outlier handling):
```
avg_loss: 2.14
instr_exact_match: 0.62
summarization_rouge_L: 0.45
time_per_token: 0.012s  (on A100-80GB, batch=1)
```
notes: instr_exact_match down 6% vs baseline. latency good but quality drop notable on multi-turn instruction chains.

alvin: Try re-running with outlier handling and group=32, and evaluate KV cache compatibility. Also try better quant config:
```
./scripts/quantize.sh --bits 4 --group 32 --outlier-threshold 3.0 --perchannel
```

rita: I'll reserve an H100 node for the longctx perf runs. Also we need to add logging opt-out for their regulated data and ensure KMS keys are used for model artifacts.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: model archipelago-15b-int4-canary -> eng-stage at 1777624700, capacity 2 replicas. CI: passed.

sam: Good. Prioritization: label as P1 for eng-ml with safety gating. If the second quant config recovers >=90% of baseline instr_exact_match and no safety flags, then proceed to canary + customer opt-in.

maya: Action items & owners:
 - maya: run q4 G32 + outlier + eval against VaultDocs prompt set (ETA: 24h)
 - alvin: prepare canary rollout plan + perf tests (ETA: 48h)
 - rita: schedule H100, verify KMS + logging settings (ETA: 24h)
 - sam: confirm commercial terms with VaultDocs and get signoff for Dedicated trial (ETA: 72h)

maya: Uploading raw eval logs to ticket. Will update thread when q4-G32 results are in. :thumbsup:
